title: Skin Care for Gym Goers: Before, During and After Your Workout
ex: A simple gym skin care routine for India: clean face before training, towel habits, the 30-minute post-workout wash, and what to do about sweat bumps and back breakouts.
rt: Skin Care for Gym Goers: Simple Workout Routine | Mirc Glow
rd: Skin care for gym goers in India: what to do before, during and after a workout, sweat bumps, back breakouts, morning vs evening gym routine and night care.
quick: Work out with a clean face, use your own towel and pat sweat away, then wash your face and change out of sweaty clothes within about 30 minutes. Moisturise lightly afterwards, add sunscreen if you are going out in daylight, and keep rich creams for bedtime.
facts: Sweat drying on skin with oil and dust is a common cause of gym bumps
Makeup under sweat can clog pores
Damp gym clothes often trigger back and chest breakouts
Indoor workouts do not need sunscreen during the session
